who: Any overdue account whose phone number is marked invalid
action: No call. In-app push at 10:00, then email, asking the customer to update their number and pay in the app
message: Practical: update your number, pay in the app
evidence: 2,458 calls to invalid numbers reached nobody (contact rate 0.0%); push opened 40.4% of the time for these customers

who: Customer refused to pay on this loan
action: Remove from the routine list; team leader reviews affordability and hardship options
message: Supportive; discuss a plan; signpost free debt advice
evidence: 933 loans with a refusal, default rate 100.0%; payment within 48 hours after a refusal 0.0%

who: Promise to pay still open (promised date plus one day not yet passed)
action: No call. Reminder on the promised date at 09:00 (SMS on ROUTE_A if opted in, otherwise push). Back on the list if the promise is broken
message: Reminder of the promise and amount
evidence: 68.4% of promises were kept; payment within 48 hours after a promise 43.5%

action: Rest day, back on the list tomorrow
evidence: 99.9% of repeat calls came 2 to 4 days apart; 9 came the next day

who: Callable account, ranked in the top of the list (risk x balance)
action: Phone call 17:00-19:59 by the partner team
evidence: Right-party contact 47.2% at 17:00-19:59 against 37.2% at 12:00-16:59 and 30.5% at 09:00-11:59; best for every employment group

who: Callable account, after the evening slots are full, or a query is open
action: Phone call 12:00-17:29 by the in-house team, then 09:00-11:59
evidence: Afternoon contact 37.2%; queries need resolving (default rate 67.0% for loans with a query)

message: Calm follow-up on the promise; take a smaller amount today if needed
Clear and supportive: explain what happens at day 30, agree a plan, signpost free debt advice
evidence: Promise rate falls from 29.7% at days 4-7 to 4.8% at days 15-30

who: Last payment failed for a technical reason (processor time-out, authorisation error)
message: Practical, low pressure: offer to retry the payment now
evidence: Default rate 30.2% (time-out) and 31.1% (authorisation) against 41.7% for insufficient funds

message: Practical: update the card in the app

who: Insufficient funds and a payday recorded before day 30
message: Supportive: agree to take the payment on the next payday
evidence: Payment within 48 hours after calls 0-3 days after payday 15.5% against 12.1% at 4-7 days; due dates 22-31 days after payday default 8.0% against 3.5% at 0-3 days

who: Insufficient funds and no payday recorded (self-employed, gig, students, unemployed)
message: Supportive: part payment now and dates for the rest before day 30
evidence: Payday is recorded for none of these groups; payment within 48 hours after calls: gig 11.1%, full-time 13.7%

who: Callable but below the day's call capacity
action: WhatsApp at 10:00 (valid number), SMS on ROUTE_A if opted in
message: Short reminder with amount and pay link
evidence: WhatsApp paid within 48 hours 6.3% against 4.7% push and 4.0% email (valid numbers)

who: Due today and in the top 20% of Model A early-warning risk
action: Due-day SMS on ROUTE_A at 08:00 plus WhatsApp (or push if invalid number) at 10:00
message: Friendly reminder of the amount and pay link
evidence: Model A top 10% has default rate 30.8% against base 11.0%; a reminder only helps if it is delivered, see R7

action: Send on ROUTE_A only and never to customers who have not opted in
evidence: Reminder delivery about 90.8% on ROUTE_A against 23.3% on ROUTE_B
